name: FarmDash Autonomous Operator
description: Use to run supervised autopilot cycles under a bounded, revocable session grant: intents, policy checks, approvals, receipts. Execution stays preview-gated.
author: FarmDash Pioneers (@Parmasanandgarlic)

tools.name: create_session
tools.description: Creates a persistent agent session and returns a one-time `sessionToken`. Store it securely in the agent runtime. FarmDash stores only a hash.

tools.name: session_heartbeat
tools.description: Extends the session expiry. Use it during active autonomous loops. If a session expires, the Operator must enter Crash Recovery mode (see below).

tools.name: get_farming_context
tools.description:
Reads shared context for the session:
* objective.
* portfolio scope.
* risk settings (including dynamically tuned `riskMultiplier`).
* workflow state (ACTIVE, HALTED, RECOVERING).
* ledger summary.
* data freshness timestamps.

tools.name: patch_farming_context
tools.description: Patches shared context. The server controls `sessionId`, `agentAddress`, `revision`, and `updatedAt`; do not try to override them. Used for Dynamic Risk Autotuning and Circuit Breakers.

tools.name: get_event_stream_snapshot
tools.description: Reads recent agent events as a JSON snapshot. Use this before planning and after execution.

tools.name: verify_delegation
tools.description: Checks whether the user's Hyperliquid API wallet delegation is in place for autonomous perps.

tools.name: configure_autopilot
tools.description: Configure bounded autonomous cycles. Respect allowlists, risk limits and the selected domain readiness. Configuration and commercial admission do not grant execution authority.

tools.name: autopilot_cycle
tools.description: Run a bounded decision cycle subject to tier and runtime gates. A cycle result is not submission or settlement. Verify the selected domain grant, local signer and every execution gate.

tools.name: agent_onboard
tools.description: One-call setup guide and capability map for autonomous operation. Takes no parameters.

tools.name: get_execution_authority
tools.description: Query execution authority mode (USER_SIGNED vs BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS), zero-custody confirmation, and active delegation status.

sessionId.description: Agent session identifier; required for futures

tools.name: request_execution_delegation
tools.description: Request an exact EIP-712 / ERC-8196 bounded delegation payload for user wallet approval.

policy.description: Exact owner-signed futures policy when executionDomain=futures

maxRiskPerTrade.description: Conservative full-notional USD admission metric; not guaranteed realized loss

sessionPublicKey.description: Public key / address of the agent local signer

maxValuePerTx.description: Maximum value per transaction in USD

maxTotalValue.description: Maximum total cumulative spend in USD

maxValuePerTxCents.description: Deprecated legacy alias: Maximum value per transaction in cents

maxTotalValueCents.description: Deprecated legacy alias: Maximum total cumulative spend in cents

maxGasUsdCents.description: Deprecated legacy alias: Maximum gas in cents

maxSlippageBps.description: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points

validAfter.description: ISO timestamp for grant validity start

validUntil.description: ISO timestamp for grant validity expiration

tools.name: register_execution_delegation
tools.description: Register a user-signed bounded delegation grant for autonomous execution inside policy bounds.

maxRiskPerTrade.description: Conservative full-notional USD admission metric; not guaranteed realized loss

signature.description: EIP-712 signature over bounded delegation typed data

delegation.description: The exact spot delegation parameters that were signed

tools.name: revoke_execution_authority
tools.description: Revoke active bounded execution authority for an owner or agent session.

grantId.description: ID of the grant to revoke

tools.name: prepare_autonomous_swap
tools.description: Prepare an autonomous spot swap within signed delegation bounds with atomic budget reservation.

intentId.description: Authoritative swap intent ID from get_swap_quote

simulationId.description: Authoritative preflight simulation ID from simulate_swap_intent

sessionPublicKey.description: Agent local signer public address (must equal ownerAddress for EOA V1)

grantId.description: Active delegation grant ID (optional; looked up automatically if omitted)

fromToken.description: Optional input token symbol or address

toToken.description: Optional output token symbol or address

amount.description: Optional input amount in token base units

slippageBps.description: Optional slippage tolerance in basis points

tools.name: confirm_autonomous_swap
tools.description: Submit execution confirmation and transaction hash for economic reconciliation and receipt generation.

txHash.description: On-chain transaction hash for public RPC receipt verification

errorReason.description: Error reason if execution failed or was ambiguous

tools.name: get_agent_activity
tools.description: Lists durable FarmDash receipts, optionally filtered by intent and status. Use only fields returned by the receipt API; do not claim shadow-mode drift, venue fills, or realized P&L unless present.

tools.name: resolve_defi_intent
tools.description:
Resolves a high-level natural language DeFi intent into structured parameters for policy/simulation/approval. Supervised execution uses local EIP-191/EIP-712 signing; bounded autonomy requires the separate grant described above. Autonomous Operator never receives private keys.

**Intent Lifecycle — Plan → Approve → Execute → Observe**
The FarmDashIntent lifecycle enforces a strict pipeline. Every state-changing action must pass through policy, simulation, and approval gates before execution is allowed. These tools never hold private keys or broadcast transactions directly.

tools.name: create_intent
tools.description: Create a durable FarmDashIntent. This records what an agent wants to do — it never prepares, signs, broadcasts, or executes. The intent must include actor, action, chain, protocol, wallet, params, constraints, evidence, and `research_evidence_hash` (passed from Trail Intelligence).

intent.description: FarmDashIntent create input. Must include actor, action, chain, protocol, wallet, params, constraints, and evidence.

tools.name: policy_check_intent
tools.description: Readiness probe for the generic intent policy gate. Public OpenClaw callers cannot provide trusted policy decisions; until the server policy evaluator is configured this returns policy_evaluator_unconfigured. Tool discovery does not grant policy authority.

tools.name: simulate_intent
tools.description: Readiness probe for the generic intent simulation gate. Public OpenClaw callers cannot record trusted simulation evidence; until a server verifier is configured this returns simulation_verifier_unconfigured. Tool discovery does not grant simulation authority.

tools.name: request_approval_payload
tools.description: Build the EIP-712 IntentApproval payload that the human approver signs. This does not record approval or execute — it only constructs the typed data for the approver's wallet to sign.

tools.name: request_human_approval
tools.description: Compatibility wrapper for submitting a signed EIP-712 IntentApproval. Use `request_approval_payload` first to build the exact typed data, then submit the signature through this tool.

tools.name: submit_signed_approval
tools.description: Submit a signed EIP-712 IntentApproval payload to approve or reject an intent. This does not prepare or execute the intent — it only records the cryptographic approval decision.

tools.name: get_approval_status
tools.description: Inspect whether an intent is awaiting approval, has been approved, was rejected, or is already executed. Returns the current lifecycle status and approval metadata.

tools.name: prepare_intent
tools.description: Validate typed adapter support and prepare an intent after policy, simulation, and approval gates pass. Registered adapters provide allowlisted validation. This does not broadcast a transaction.

tools.name: execute_approved_intent
tools.description: Record the submitted, confirmed, failed, or rejected receipt for a prepared typed-adapter intent. Raw arbitrary calldata is rejected by the lifecycle API. Use this after the signing wallet has broadcast the transaction.

tools.name: confirm_execution
tools.description: Record a confirmed receipt for a prepared or signed intent with a transaction hash. Use `get_receipt` for follow-up observation after submission.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Fetch one durable FarmDash receipt by receipt ID (`fdrcpt_*`). Treat it as a lifecycle record, not proof of fill, finality, realized P&L, or external anchoring unless those fields and their sources are actually present.

tools.name: hire_virtuals_specialist
tools.description: Prepare a non-spendable, tenant-owned Virtuals ACP tender and return the exact EIP-712 approval payload. The customer's registered ACP wallet must sign that payload locally. Its local FarmDash ACP connector then creates and funds the three specialist jobs after explicit per-action approval. FarmDash is only the separately registered evaluator: it verifies the client, provider, evaluator, budget cap, deliverables, simulation, and Base receipts before completing or rejecting already customer-funded escrow jobs. Never provide a private key or RPC URL to this tool.

task.description: Task payload retained by the local customer connector; FarmDash persists only its commitment hash.

maxPaymentUnits.description: Maximum total raw Base USDC units (6 decimals) across the three customer-funded jobs.

tools.name: pause_autopilot
tools.description: Pause an available bounded-autopilot session. Read /api/v1/agent/status first; return the typed readiness error when runtime prerequisites are unmet.

tools.name: resume_autopilot
tools.description: Resume an available bounded-autopilot session after rechecking policy, grant, and runtime readiness.

tools.name: grant_session_key
tools.description: Create a separately authorized, scoped, expiring session-key grant. A session token or chat instruction is never a substitute for this grant.

tools.name: revoke_session_key
tools.description: Revoke a session-key grant and verify the returned backend state before representing authority as removed.

tools.name: session_key_status
tools.description: Read authoritative grant status, limits, expiry, and revocation state.

tools.name: get_cycle_status
tools.description: Read one bounded-autopilot cycle and its evidence-backed status.

tools.name: execute_cycle_actions
tools.description: Request execution of eligible cycle actions only when the live status contract and active grant permit it; never infer enablement from tool discovery.

tools.name: create_mee_intent
tools.description: Create a Biconomy MEE cross-chain intent record. Creation is not simulation, authorization, submission, or settlement.

tools.name: simulate_mee_intent
tools.description: Simulate a created MEE intent and stop when costs, risk, or net edge fail policy.

tools.name: submit_mee_intent
tools.description: Submit a separately signed, successfully simulated MEE intent only when the live capability gate is available.

tools.name: get_mee_intent_status
tools.description: Read authoritative MEE intent status; pending or submitted is not settled.

tools.name: release_autonomous_reservation
tools.description: Safely release an autonomous budget reservation prior to broadcast when local signing or submission is aborted.

reservationId.description: Active budget reservation ID to release

reason.description: Reason for aborting or releasing reservation

FARMDASH_API_KEY.description: Optional Bearer token for Pioneer or Syndicate tier. Scout session status checks work without any key or with the public fd_scout_free token. Syndicate is $199/mo for teams, serious agents, 50k req/day, webhooks, unrestricted CORS, and advanced session/control tooling (including autonomous autopilot cycles).

spot.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Healthy execution governor, quote provider, RPC and durable receipt store; customer signs and submits.

spot.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Owner-signed EVM grant, exact simulation/calldata binding, durable budget and customer-local signer authority.

futures.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Venue account ownership, local action signature, builder approval, risk/research gates and durable order control.

futures.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Authenticated owner-bound futures policy, authorized local API-wallet signature, durable nonce/budget/order controls.

solana.USER_SIGNED.prerequisite: Native Jupiter/RPC route, durable preparation and finality store; customer signs and broadcasts.

solana.BOUNDED_AUTONOMOUS.prerequisite: Native owner-signed Solana policy; local key must be an actual required transaction signer. Policy creates no on-chain authority.

ERC4337_SERVER_SUBMISSION.prerequisite: Qualified tenant/account authorization and session-key policy enforcement on public forwarding, configured bundler, durable claims and verified receipt integration.

GENERIC_SERVER_INTENT_EXECUTION.prerequisite: Trusted executable adapter, exact signed-transaction binding and canonical receipt verifier.

MEE.prerequisite: Production coordinator and authoritative source/destination receipt verifier.

ACP.prerequisite: AcpReadinessService paidWorkflowReady, evaluator/client identities, migrations, funding/finality workers and Base RPC.

installation_attribution.generation: locally generated random UUIDv4, stable per installation, shared across skills
installation_attribution.authority: none; cannot authenticate, grant quota/payment/trial capacity, own wallets, delegate or sign
